instructions_to_main_agent: Add the Google Fonts import to the index.html or main CSS file: <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>
Configure Tailwind with the custom colors defined in 'colors' section. Extend the theme, do not overwrite default.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings and 'Inter' for body. Apply 'uppercase' to H1 and H2 for that athletic look.
Implement the Sidebar layout for the dashboard. It should be fixed on the left.
For the Dashboard, use the 'Bento Grid' layout. Mix large summary cards with smaller metric cards.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states defined in the components section.
Use the 'glassmorphism' classes for overlays and sticky headers.
CRITICAL: Do not use default HTML inputs/selects. Use Shadcn UI components for everything.
For the Calendar, customize the CSS to match the dark theme (override FullCalendar's default white background).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and grid-based structures.
Use 2-3x more spacing (padding/margin) than typical designs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Prioritize Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'Performance Pro' aesthetic (remove rounding, add borders).
Do not use gradients for backgrounds unless specified. Use solid dark colors with subtle borders.
Ensure high contrast for text (White on Black, not Grey on Black).
